_about: Bernard Bosanquet (1848-1923), in his own works, raw IA OCR: The Philosophical Theory of the State (Macmillan, 1899) and A History of Aesthetic (Swan Sonnenschein, 1892). His editions of Lotze and his Hegel translation are on the lotze and hegel-translations shelves. Added in round ac: Knowledge and Reality, a criticism of Mr. F. H. Bradley's Principles of Logic (London: Kegan Paul, Trench, 1885); The Principle of Individuality and Value, Gifford Lectures for 1911 (London: Macmillan, 1912). US public domain. Wanted: Logic, or the Morphology of Knowledge (1888), Knowledge and Reality (1885), The Principle of Individuality and Value (1912). No uids minted.
